select.option: Use my own title and icon

div.label: Panic key
Panic key opens
div.p: Press the panic key anywhere on Goop to jump to that page. It is off until you set a key. If a game has focus, click outside it first.

dl.dd: Go back, or leave a game

div.label: Use NoSW for browser navigation
Game files hosting base URL
div.p: Optional custom host for your game files. By default, Goop loads community game files from public mirrors; availability varies by game.
These projects must be hosted as running services. Enter your deployed HTTPS server URLs below.
